data_source: Yahoo Finance chart endpoint, historical daily close/adjusted close snapshots
calculation: simple close-to-close return, adjusted closes for ETFs; returns start on scenario start using the preceding available close as base
calendar: US equity sessions; BTC-USD is sampled at the same UTC date labels and weekend moves are folded into next US-session return
limitations: BTC did not have a traded market during the 2008 Lehman window and is intentionally absent.
VT is a total-world equity ETF proxy in 2008, not an MSCI World index history.
URTH is an MSCI World ETF proxy in 2020; it is not the licensed MSCI index series.
IEF proxies intermediate 7-10 year US Treasury total returns, not the full Treasury market index.
S&P 500 series is the price index and excludes dividends; ETF adjusted closes include distributions.
